source_slug: 2025-06-23 Libya's PM Dabaiba approves Unified Social Registry project

fact: LANA reports that on 22 June 2025 Prime Minister Dabaiba approved the draft Unified Social Registry document, built on a unified database of citizens' social and economic information with a classification system by income, health status and family size and periodic data updates.
UNICEF Libya announced that the Tripoli-based government, with UN agencies, has launched the Unified Social Registry to identify and target those in need for social protection programmes.
